tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List business services currently offered for sale on PreviewFix, with prices, turnaround, and accepted preview input fields.

tools.name: run_preview
tools.description: Run a free live preview for a sellable service (same validation, vertical screening, SSRF protection, rate limits, and per-preview cost cap as /api/preview, plus a per-service daily budget cap). Returns a preview token, summary blocks, and solveUrl.

tools.name: get_preview
tools.description: Retrieve an existing preview result and summary blocks using the token returned by run_preview.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Create an order and return a hosted Stripe checkout URL (or PayPal when enabled) for a preview token. Never charges automatically — hand the returned checkoutUrl to the human buyer so they can review and pay in a browser.

tools.name: check_order_status
tools.description: Check status, progress events, and expiring deliverable download links for an order. Strictly requires BOTH the order reference and the matching preview token.
